title: Prawn tarka salad bowl
summary: Prawn tarka salad bowl is a indian dinner built around raw king prawns and cucumber, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook raw king prawns for Prawn tarka salad bowl in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm cherry tomatoes alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss cucumber with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Prawn tarka salad bowl straight away. Taste Prawn tarka salad bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
